name: ChemDraft (元素智研)
tierReason: It supports complete 2D drawing documents with reaction schemes, publication styles, editable annotations and export for publication.
summary: Chemical drawing software for molecular structures, reaction schemes, publication figures, and editable Office documents.
vendor: 深圳元素智研科技有限公司

license.text: Proprietary; individual drawing is free, with noncommercial use by default.

price.text: Free individual drawing (2026-11-05); enterprise services require a quote.

bonds-core.note: Single, double and triple bonds; manual bond-order changes.

stereo-bonds.note: Solid wedge, hashed wedge and wavy bonds explicitly listed.

special-bonds.note: Dative, hydrogen and quadruple bonds explicitly listed.

double-bond-side.note: Direction cycling documented; left/right/center states not individually specified.

rings.note: Three- through eight-membered rings and benzene tools.

conformers.note: Dedicated left and right chair conformation tools.

chains.note: Drag zigzag chains with live carbon counts.

templates.note: Functional groups, amino acids, peptides, sugars and supramolecular templates.

custom-templates.note: Save selected structures into the custom template library.

abbreviations.note: Chemically recognized groups expand and collapse.

atom-labels.note: Elements and charges supported; general isotope mass editing unverified.

radicals.note: Atom-associated radical dots and lone-pair markers.

keyboard-drawing.note: Hover atoms or bonds, then press drawing shortcuts.

selection-tools.note: Lasso selection, scaling, rotation and flips documented across editing sections.

perspective.note: Rotate editable canvas structures to change their perspective.

reaction-arrows.note: Forward, equilibrium, resonance and retrosynthetic arrows.

mechanism-arrows.note: Electron-transfer arrows with editable curvature and arrowhead styles.

reaction-data.note: Recognizes reactant/product relationships; reaction-format storage not documented.

orbitals.note: Editable orbital shapes, including s, p, d and f.

rich-text.note: Canvas text supports fonts, subscripts and superscripts.

shapes.note: Editable shapes, brackets, arcs and free curves.

align.note: Object alignment and horizontal or vertical equal distribution.

groups.note: Group, move collectively, edit members and ungroup.

cleanup.note: Normalizes bond lengths, angles, rings and overall layout.

journal-styles.note: ACS, RSC and Nature presets explicitly listed.

custom-styles.note: Custom mode saves bond, font and other drawing parameters.

color.note: Selected objects support individual line and fill colors.

pages.note: Page sizes and margins documented; multipage documents unverified.

pictures.note: Import PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF and WebP images.

valence-check.note: Structure problems receive red warning borders.

stereo-perception.note: Automatically computes atom R/S and bond E/Z descriptors.

formula-mass.note: Computes molecular formula, exact mass and molecular weight.

name-to-structure.note: Converts pasted IUPAC names into editable 2D structures.

structure-to-name.note: Generates IUPAC names that update with structure edits.

nmr-prediction.note: Predicts proton and carbon-13 chemical shifts and spectra.

markush.note: Markush attachment markers documented; full R-group/query handling unverified.

polymers.note: Recognizes bracket-associated repeat units and supports polymer connection points.

image-to-structure.note: PNG/JPG uploads and screenshots become editable chemical structures.

database-lookup.note: Searches PubChem/Reaxys externally; structure retrieval into editor unverified.

cdxml.note: Import and export explicitly documented; clipboard exchange also supported.

cdx.note: Import and export explicitly documented; clipboard exchange also supported.

mol-sdf.note: MOL, including V2000, and SDF import/export explicitly documented.

engine.library: RDKit FileParsers (C++ compiled to browser WebAssembly; confirmed MOL import)

smiles.note: Clipboard export; import through Special Paste in section 11.3.

engine.library: RDKit SmilesWrite (vendor SciRDKit C++ compiled to browser WebAssembly; confirmed SMILES clipboard export)

inchi.note: Copies structures as InChI and InChIKey.

engine.library: RDKit InChI adapter with InChI 1.07.3 (C/C++ compiled to browser WebAssembly; confirmed InChI clipboard export)

pdf-export.note: PDF export documented; vector output not specified.

png-export.note: PNG export documented; 300-dpi output not specified.

clipboard-chemdraw.note: Editable ChemDraw import; reverse direct clipboard editing unverified.

office.note: Double-click embedded Office/WPS structures to edit and update them.

embed.note: Vendor-arranged integration; commercial use requires separate authorization.

ai-assistant.note: Built-in assistant generates editable structures, mechanisms and routes on canvas.

office-ole.note: Word/PowerPoint objects reopen ChemDraft on double-click; edits update the document.

caveats: Service terms restrict use to noncommercial purposes unless otherwise authorized.
The browser edition has fewer functions; Linux and mobile clients are listed as coming soon.
Live downloads supply 0.9.43 beta and Mac PKG; older pages claim 2.1.0, DMG, or additional platforms.

hands.failure: The editor opened with a WeChat sign-in panel; Escape and canvas clicks did not dismiss it. Testing stopped without signing in.
observations: Startup displayed a WeChat sign-in panel.
The build identifier comes from the hosted version.json.

builtOn.note: Vendor claims independent development; external chemistry dependencies remain undisclosed.

embedding.limit: Vendor-arranged integration; commercial use requires separate authorization.
embedding.how: Contact vendor for JavaScript editor integration; public setup instructions unavailable.
